name: Eternal Siege
storyline: The king has exiled his brother for treason (or so we are told). You are an army General returning from a long trip, tasked with defending the kings city against his brothers attacks. In this strategical resource management tower defense, you will die...Eventually. There is no end to the eternal waves of attacks, but how long can you survive? Can you outlive the human era and reach the leaderboard?
summary: Eternal Siege is a tower defense game based around resource management, efficient use of spells, upgrading systems, and (hopefully) building some towers. Start in the Ancient Greek era, and develop a strategy to survive the human extinction to battle for the top of the leaderboard.
